senses.zh_definition: 外语人名；在 DC《闪电侠》相关语境中，通常指逆闪电 Eobard Thawne 名字中的 Eobard。
senses.en_definition: A personal name, notably the given name of Eobard Thawne, the DC character known as the Reverse-Flash.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, khususnya nama pertama Eobard Thawne, watak DC yang dikenali sebagai Reverse-Flash.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词，规范书写为 Eobard；小写仅保留输入键。缺少原始上下文时，不能断定每次出现都指 DC 角色。此处马来语释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 官方释义；输入排名也不构成官方词频证据。[DC 角色说明](https://www.dc.com/blog/2016/01/15/whats-the-difference-between-the-reverse-flash-and-zoom)

etymology.historical_story: Eobard is best treated here as a fictional personal name, not as a Malay word with recoverable affixes. DC identifies Eobard Thawne with the Reverse-Flash and Professor Zoom, while distinguishing him from Hunter Zolomon. That distinction explains why recognizing the whole name matters more than inventing a literal translation or an unsupported ancient origin. [DC](https://www.dc.com/blog/2016/01/15/whats-the-difference-between-the-reverse-flash-and-zoom)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 整名配画面：Eobard → 逆闪电 → 一道朝反方向奔跑的黄色闪电；这是角色联想，不是词源拆解。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 讨论角色时使用 Eobard 或 Eobard Thawne 即可；它不是马来语称谓，也不表达尊敬或亲疏。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于漫画、影视和粉丝交流。面对不熟悉作品的读者，首次出现时补充角色身份；讨论尚未看过的剧情时先提醒可能涉及剧透。
